```{r}
#| label: setup
library(ggplot2)
library(TempleCBE)

theme_set(theme_temple())
```

# Introduction

This template renders to four formats. `temple-html` and `temple-typst` need
only Quarto; `temple-pdf` needs a LaTeX installation (e.g.
`tinytex::install_tinytex()`) and adds the Temple title page. With
`titlepage-corresponding-only: true`, only the author marked
`corresponding: true` appears under Correspondence; `titlepage-corner: false`
would drop the cherry corner graphic instead. References come from `bib.bib`
[@Al-Helali2021-as].

# Data

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mtcars
#| tbl-cap: "First rows of `mtcars`."
knitr::kable(head(mtcars[, 1:6]))
```

# Figures

`theme_temple()` and the `scale_*_temple()` scales keep figures in the brand
palette, as in @fig-scatter and @fig-missing.

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Mileage by weight and cylinder count."
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_temple() +
  labs(x = "Weight (1000 lb)", y = "Miles per gallon", colour = "Cylinders")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-missing
#| fig-cap: "Share of missing values per feature."
df <- airquality
plot_features_percent_miss(df)
```
